status: selected on validation 2026-11-09; review and clean rerun required before final test
window_label: any annotated sample in current-inclusive trailing window
event_match: start <= selected alert index <= end; each event counted once across blocks
recall_aggregation: sum detected events / sum annotated events
warmup_events: retain all events in denominator, including unscored warmup
block_assignment: original sample index // 1000, separately for each channel
alert_ranking: descending score, then ascending original sample index
suppression_scope: within block; reject distances <= 10; no cross-block suppression
fit_policy: fit models, scaling, and PCA on training channels only; no validation refit
selection_rule: maximize validation detected events, then minimize false alerts; prefer simpler settings on ties

baseline.zero_variance: score 0 for unchanged value; largest finite float for changed value

pca_auxiliary.decision: retain original features for primary logistic comparison; report observed PCA tradeoff

selection_limitations: exploratory validation tuning; staged rather than full joint search; no uncertainty established yet
